historical_event.name: First Battle of Panipat
historical_event.description: Central Asian conqueror Babur defeats Sultan Ibrahim Lodi, establishing the Mughal Empire in India.

techmeme.title: John Ternus, senior VP of Hardware Engineering, will become Apple's next CEO on September 1; Tim Cook will become executive chairman of Apple's board
techmeme.context: Apple said on Monday that John Ternus is succeeding Tim Cook as CEO, with Cook assuming the role of executive chairman on Sept. 1.

techmeme.title: Apple says Johny Srouji, who most recently served as senior VP of Hardware Technologies, will assume an expanded role leading Hardware Engineering
techmeme.context: Apple today announced that, effective immediately, Apple executive Johny Srouji will become chief hardware officer.

techmeme.title: In an email to employees, Johny Srouji details newly combined hardware engineering and hardware technologies division, organized across five key areas
techmeme.context: Apple Inc.'s newly combined hardware engineering and hardware technologies division will be organized across five key areas, its new leader told staffers on Monday.

sciencedaily.title: Breakthrough discovery reveals hidden oxygen flow deep inside catalysts
sciencedaily.summary: A major discovery is reshaping how scientists think about catalysts. Researchers have, for the first time, captured oxygen atoms moving through the interior of a catalyst—not just along its surface. This reveals that the bulk material can actively participate in reactions, opening a new frontier in catalyst design.

bigthink.title: There is no you in your brain — your identity is a "society of the mind"
bigthink.relevance: Aborda cómo la identidad emerge de procesos cognitivos complejos, no de una región cerebral única, ofreciendo una perspectiva neurocientífica moderna sobre el yo.
